## PinballWizard Ops

Live signal for the six Phase 6 SLIs. See [runbooks](https://github.com/Early-Bird-Solutions-LLC/PinballWizard/tree/main/docs/runbooks/) for response procedures.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where name == 'pinwiz.ai.duration_ms'
| summarize p50=percentile(value,50), p95=percentile(value,95) by bin(timestamp,1h)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Wizard answer latency (p50 / p95)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where url contains '/api/wizard/'
| summarize total=count(), errors5xx=countif(resultCode startswith '5') by bin(timestamp,10m)
| extend errorRate=todouble(errors5xx)/todouble(total)*100
| project timestamp, errorRate
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: 5xx error rate — /api/wizard/* (%)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp > ago(30d)
| where name == 'pinwiz.ai.cost_usd_cents'
| summarize dailyCostCents=sum(value) by bin(timestamp,1d), model=tostring(customDimensions['model'])
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Daily AI cost (cents, by model)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where name == 'pinwiz.ai.refusals'
| summarize count=sum(valueCount) by category=tostring(customDimensions['refusal_category'])
| order by count desc
content.title: Refusal breakdown (trailing 24 h)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp > ago(1h)
| where name in ('pinwiz.rag.changefeed_lease_lag', 'pinwiz.rag.changefeed_dead_letter_total')
| summarize currentValue=max(value) by name
| project metric=name, value=currentValue
content.title: RAG changefeed health (trailing 1 h)

content.query:
availabilityResults
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| summarize pass=countif(success==1), fail=countif(success==0), total=count() by bin(timestamp,30m)
| extend successRate=todouble(pass)/todouble(total)*100
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Availability synthetic test (trailing 24 h)
